title: Kettle care | Example Coffee
text: Descaling a kettle every month keeps your water tasting clean. Fill the kettle halfway with equal parts water and white vinegar, bring it to a boil, then let it sit for twenty minutes. Pour the solution out, rinse three times with fresh water and boil once more with plain water to remove any smell. If you prefer citric acid, dissolve two tablespoons in a full kettle of water, boil, wait fifteen minutes and rinse well. Hard water areas may need this every two weeks. Wipe the outside with a soft cloth.
